<!--
  Title this as a plain description of what you want, not as a conventional-commit
  subject: "a way to preview changes before applying them", not "feat(preview): ...".
  This template applies Kind/Feature. If you are improving something that already
  exists, say so in the Summary and a maintainer will swap the label to
  Kind/Enhancement at triage.

  Delete these comments as you fill the issue in.
-->

## Summary

What you want, in one or two sentences. Lead with the capability, not the implementation.

## Problem

What is awkward, slow or impossible today. Be concrete about the situation that led you here.

## Proposed behavior

The concrete shape of the change: names, inputs, outputs, error paths, and what happens with
missing input or a missing dependency.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why you set them aside. Drop this heading if there were none.

## Acceptance criteria

What must be true for this issue to close, one observable outcome per line. Include the docs
and tests the change will owe. Leave the boxes unchecked; they are ticked as the work lands.

- [ ] 
- [ ] 

## Notes

Prior art, links, related issues (`Refs #N`). Drop this heading if empty.
